master_plan_principles_consumed.principle_text: Owner has final authority over internal QTT workflow behavior.
Owner override may satisfy internal QTT workflow requirements when canonically recorded.
Owner override cannot fabricate external facts or convert facts into truth by assertion.
Owner override cannot make a missing accepted source packet true.
Connector semantic values require accepted source packets and binding gates.
Runtime cash receipts remain future receipt-backed artifacts.
Owner override cannot fabricate account balance, open order, order, or fill receipts.
Replay and paper results remain separate result packets and cannot be invented.
Quantum backend output requires future backend evidence and cannot be fabricated.
Profit evidence and quantum advantage evidence require receipt-backed evidence.
Risk gates and the execution router remain required before live order action.
Owner policy changes require canonical record before Codex or runtime consumption.
Owner policy changes may not retroactively rewrite historical receipt facts.
Agents may request; owner decides.
Agents, Codex, and ChatGPT may not approve for owner.
A request, template, proposal, or dashboard item is not automatic approval.
Review artifacts do not create automatic live promotion.
Accepted source packets are required for source-dependent live connector fields.
Connector semantic binding is required before live connector use.
Runtime cash receipts remain required where current policy requires them.
Risk and order-router gates remain required before live order action.
Execution router remains final order-submission authority.
Dashboard approval menu and static screen are later PRs.
Canary eligibility remains a later gate.
Live reachability and order execution remain later scopes.
Replay and paper results must remain separate.
AtomicRows is inventory, not a trader or direct live order authority.
Single parameter or single algorithm trade selection is forbidden.
Required roles include SIGNAL, SCORING, NORMALIZATION, RISK, EXECUTION, CAPITAL, LATENCY, and ERROR_GUARD.
Blocked rows may appear only as diagnostics and cannot become active selected stacks or live promotion proof.
Quantum optimizer may rank/refine only as future-gated/static metadata and cannot become direct live order authority.
Classical execution gates remain final for execution release.

No fabrication of source claims, connector semantics, runtime receipts, replay/paper results, owner approval receipts, owner override receipts beyond internal workflow scope, AtomicRows bundle creation, test pass claims, quantum backend values, profit, or advantage evidence.
